entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker and invulnerable warrior who leads the army of Zendikar and holds Ulamog back while the hedron trap is completed.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A mind mage and planeswalker who returns from the Eye of Ugin with a plan to build a hedron trap for Ulamog.

entities.name: Kiora
entities.description: A merfolk planeswalker who wields the god's bident and leads a sea assault, refusing to wait for the trap.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: An elf planeswalker with glowing green eyes who commands Zendikar's land and elementals, and finds the misaligned hedron by sharing Jace's illusion.

entities.name: Ashaya
entities.description: Nissa's elemental, her closest friend and Zendikar's soul.

entities.name: Drana
entities.description: The vampire leader who commands a legion and wants an assault on Ulamog.

entities.name: Tazri
entities.description: A human commander with a glowing halo around her neck who argues for evacuation and defends the trap plan.

entities.name: Munda
entities.description: A kor commander who fights at Gideon's side and directs the hedron teams.

entities.name: Jori En
entities.description: An armored merfolk who runs to warn Gideon about Ulamog after escaping with Jace.

entities.name: Ebi
entities.description: A kor sentry whom Gideon stationed around Sea Gate; he is seized by a demon.

entities.name: Seble
entities.description: An elf airborne sentry mounted on a manta who spots the titan.

entities.name: Noyan Dar
entities.description: A merfolk leader of the roilmages who helped win Sea Gate.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: A dragon planeswalker whose warnings about trapping the Eldrazi Jace recalls.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker whose rose Jace dropped when he followed the wounded Gideon on Ravnica.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan that approaches Sea Gate through the bay and is pulled into the hedron prison.

entities.name: Ula
entities.description: A god of Zendikar whose bident Kiora holds and calls on.

entities.name: Bident of Thassa
entities.description: A forked spear that Kiora wields to call the tide, which she claims is the most powerful artifact on Zendikar.

entities.name: Hedron trap
entities.description: A ring of floating hedrons aligned by leylines over the water to imprison Ulamog.

entities.name: Army of Zendikar
entities.description: The ragtag force of kor, merfolk, elves, humans, goblins and vampires that holds Sea Gate.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Alien creatures led by the titans, including scions and spawn that swarm Sea Gate.

entities.name: Gideon's Irregulars
entities.description: Gideon's former group of friends on Theros, whose deaths he still carries.

entities.name: Sea Gate
entities.description: The city on the coast of Tazeem retaken by Gideon's army and now defended against Ulamog.

entities.name: Eye of Ugin
entities.description: The center of the hedron network that Jace visited.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane whose land fights alongside Nissa.

entities.name: Hedrons
entities.description: Floating stone hedrons that hold power and are connected by leylines.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The city-plane where Gideon came near death to beg Jace for help.

entities.name: Sky Rock
entities.description: A place where Jace left Gideon earlier.

events.summary: Kiora climbs the lighthouse and enters Gideon's meeting of advisors uninvited.
events.quote: Her lack of invitation was clearly an oversight. She marched in.

events.summary: Jori En bursts in with news that Ulamog is coming and that Jace delayed her return so she could warn them.
Tazri argues for evacuation while Drana, Nissa and Kiora argue for an assault.
events.quote: An assault is the only reason I'm here,

events.summary: Kiora volunteers to lead the offensive and demonstrates the bident by sending a wave through the window.
events.quote: Only the most powerful artifact on all of Zendikar

events.summary: Gideon, after a moment alone, orders that they will not evacuate but stay, fight and kill the titan.
events.quote: We do not evacuate. We stay and we fight. And we kill the titan.

events.summary: Gideon assigns Nissa to lead land forces and Kiora to coordinate a sea attack.
events.quote: you will coordinate a sea attack.

events.summary: Ebi brings Jace to the lighthouse, and Gideon embraces his friend.
events.quote: Gideon closed the distance and embraced the smaller man

events.summary: Jace pitches the hedron trap, but Kiora insists on attacking with the bident and Nissa objects to trapping the titan.
Jace warns that a failed assault could drive Ulamog onto another world, but Kiora strikes at him with the bident and leaves on a tentacle; Gideon deflects the blow.
events.quote: Gideon was deflecting the strike of Kiora's bident meant for Jace.

events.summary: Gideon orders the army to build the trap and assigns commanders to patrols, telling them to keep Kiora from interfering.
events.quote: We will build the trap, and once we have secured our target, we will launch our offensive as planned.

events.summary: Through the night Nissa and Ashaya dig up hedrons and the kor and Zendikari teams hoist them into the ring over the water.
events.quote: They pulled and tightened their ropes in opposite directions, slowing the hedron to a gentle stop.

events.summary: At dawn Seble sees Ulamog approaching, and Nissa restrains the urge to attack it alone.
events.quote: And that's when she saw the titan.

events.summary: Gideon stands alone before Ulamog while Jace rehearses the trap with illusions, and Ulamog lurches into the ring.
The ring fails to light because of a misaligned hedron.
events.quote: The ring didn't flare to life like it was supposed to.

events.summary: Nissa shares Jace's mind and illusion, and they locate the tilted hedron; Nissa leaps to it.
events.quote: The hedron was tilted; it must have shifted sometime after being carefully locked into place.

events.summary: Gideon, nearly overwhelmed by Ulamog, holds out until a blue flash lifts the pressure and the titan is pulled into the glowing prison.
events.quote: Ulamog had been pulled within the bounds of the hedron prison

events.summary: The Zendikari cheer that Ulamog is trapped.
events.quote: They had done it. Ulamog was trapped.

events.summary: A demon lands before the sentry Ebi, strangles him and leaves him unconscious.
events.quote: Take what solace you can in the knowledge that you will not be here to witness Zendikar's demise.

relations.quote: her elemental, her closest friend, and Zendikar's soul.

relations.note: Gideon embraces Jace and takes his plan as the army's.
relations.quote: Gideon closed the distance and embraced the smaller man

relations.note: Kiora is determined to slay Ulamog.
Kiora attacks Jace with the bident when he tries to read her mind.
relations.quote: Gideon was deflecting the strike of Kiora's bident meant for Jace.

relations.note: Tazri defers to Gideon as Commander-General.
relations.quote: Commander-General, do we have the order to evacuate?

relations.note: Ebi is a sentry Gideon stationed around Sea Gate.
relations.quote: Ebi, one of the sentries Gideon had stationed around Sea Gate.

relations.note: Kiora wields the bident and calls it her weapon.
relations.quote: I wield it now, that's all that matters.
